body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Darwin, Australia. It starts at 45 Stokes Hill Rd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The RFDS Darwin Tourist Facility and the Darwin Aviation Museum have come together to create an air-craft combo ticket designed to have you high-flying through Australia's aviation history!
>
> Access two of Australia's premier aviation attractions. See history come to life through VR technology, learn about the bombing of Darwin Harbour and walk around almost 20 awesome aircraft, all on display in top condition. A must for young airplane fans and potential pilots!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.70. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
